about: Real Vercel AI SDK v6 spans from its own experimental_telemetry (the ai.* dialect: ai.generateText, ai.generateText.doGenerate, ai.toolCall ...). Recorded through a scripted fetch with an AsyncLocalStorage context manager and deterministic clocks: no network, no API keys, no rius SDK. The scenarios are the v5 family's (_vercel.mjs), plus a rerank call, which v5 does not have. v6 reports usage in its detailed spelling (ai.usage.inputTokenDetails.*, ai.usage.outputTokenDetails.*) beside the v5 one, on every span.

scenarios.generate_text: generateText with a system prompt, temperature and maxOutputTokens.
scenarios.tool_loop: generateText with one tool and stopWhen: stepCountIs(2): two model calls (24/51 then 91/15 tokens) with the tool executed between them.
scenarios.embed: embed with text-embedding-3-small; the response vector is three floats. Normalization drops the vectors (ai.embedding, ai.embeddings), as it does OpenInference's.
scenarios.rerank: rerank with Cohere's rerank-v3.5 (no OpenAI model reranks): three text documents, topN 2. The AI SDK records the documents (ai.documents) and the ranking (ai.ranking, indices and scores) but not the query, and no usage. Normalization classifies both spans as the rerank operation, as @ai-sdk/otel names it, and as RERANKER.
scenarios.image_file: generateText with a user message holding a file part: a 1x1 PNG as a Buffer, media type image/png.
scenarios.pdf_file: The same with a one-page PDF, application/pdf.
scenarios.text_plain_file: The same with a text/plain file. The chat-completions provider cannot send it and rejects the call; the spans, with the prompt, are still recorded.
scenarios.audio_file: The same with a WAV file, audio/wav.
